subject: Grey-screen after 25s - but depends on connection

messages.author: 0521d492052ce0f0
messages.subject: Grey-screen after 25s - but depends on connection
parts:
I have a minimal application installed on spark, which works as expected on most internet connections.  Listings below - really minimal.

However when connecting via my local hotspot (O2 Westminster)  with excellent signal to the same URL, it reliably starts up, then equally reliably grey-screens after 25s precisely.   A colleague gets greyed-out also on his home connection.  I can connect at Starbucks and other locations just fine.

Same behaviour in Chrome V31, Explorer 11, Firefox 24.

Any suggestions as to how can I diagnose this problem? 

Thanks - Giles


truly minimal example still does this behaviour:
ui.R

  headerPanel("a"),
  sidebarPanel(),
  mainPanel()
))

server.R

shinyServer(function(input, output,session) {})
